mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS actor_user_id, u.user_role AS actor_system_role, u.is_delete AS actor_is_delete FROM `user` u WHERE u.id = #{actorUserId}

SELECT t.id AS team_id, t.owner_id AS team_owner_user_id, t.is_delete AS team_is_delete, t.deleted_at AS team_deleted_at, #{actorUserId} AS actor_user_id, actor_tm.id AS actor_team_member_id, actor_tm.role AS actor_team_role, actor_tm.is_delete AS actor_membership_is_delete, actor_tm.deleted_at AS actor_membership_deleted_at, target_tm.user_id AS target_user_id, target_tm.id AS target_team_member_id, target_tm.role AS target_team_role, target_tm.is_delete AS target_membership_is_delete, target_tm.deleted_at AS target_membership_deleted_at FROM team t LEFT JOIN team_member actor_tm ON actor_tm.team_id = t.id AND actor_tm.user_id = #{actorUserId} LEFT JOIN team_member target_tm ON target_tm.team_id = t.id AND target_tm.user_id = #{targetUserId} WHERE t.id = #{teamId}
